title: Effect of Kinesio Taping on Muscle Strength in Lower Trapezius
brief_summary: The purpose of this project is to investigate the effect of Kinesio tape on muscle strength of the lower trapezius in people with shoulder symptoms and decreased muscle strength in the lower trapezius - a randomized controlled trial.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Shoulder problems
* Low muscle strength in lower trapezius
* Positive manual recoil-test for the lower trapezius

Exclusion Criteria:

* Shoulder surgery \<3 month
* Pathology in the shoulder related to tumors, fractures, neurology, rupture of tendons
